record.original_question: For the three-machine flow-shop makespan problem F3||C_max, is the problem fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by p_max, the maximum processing time?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 11. Is F3||Cmax fixed-parameter tractable parameterized by the maximum processing time pmax?
Flow shop scheduling, denoted by “F” in the α-field: all jobs have the same set of operations with the same total order.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
In the three-machine flow-shop makespan problem, denoted F3 || C_max, one is given a set of n jobs J = {1, ..., n} and three machines M_1, M_2, M_3. Each job j has three operations o_{1,j}, o_{2,j}, o_{3,j} with nonnegative integer processing times p_{1,j}, p_{2,j}, p_{3,j}. Every job must be processed first on M_1, then on M_2, then on M_3 (the same machine order for all jobs); each machine processes at most one operation at a time, and an operation, once started, runs without preemption. A schedule assigns to each operation o_{i,j} a starting time s_{i,j} ≥ 0 such that:
(i) s_{i,j} + p_{i,j} ≤ s_{i+1,j} for i ∈ {1, 2} (job order),
(ii) for any two jobs j ≠ k and any machine M_i, the intervals [s_{i,j}, s_{i,j} + p_{i,j}) and [s_{i,k}, s_{i,k} + p_{i,k}) are disjoint (machine capacity).
The makespan is C_max = max_j (s_{3,j} + p_{3,j}), and the objective is to minimize C_max.

Let p_max = max_{i,j} p_{i,j} be the maximum processing time over all operations.

Question: Is F3 || C_max fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by p_max? That is, does there exist a computable function f and a constant c such that the optimal makespan can be computed in time f(p_max) · n^c on every instance?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not produce a clear, authoritative resolution of whether F3 || C_max is fixed-parameter tractable parameterized by p_max. The problem is listed among open problems in parameterized scheduling complexity, and while related results exist for open-shop variants (e.g., O_m || C_max being FPT in p_max) and kernels via configuration LP have been studied, no source clearly establishes either an FPT algorithm or a hardness result for F3 || C_max with parameter p_max.

status_evidence.title: Parameterized complexity of machine scheduling: 15 open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Open Problem 11. Is F3||Cmax fixed-parameter tractable parameterized by the maximum processing time pmax?
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly listed as an open problem in a survey of parameterized scheduling complexity.

status_evidence.title: Scheduling Kernels via Configuration LP
status_evidence.snippet: Kernelization results for scheduling problems parameterized by maximum processing time and related parameters.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work addresses kernels parameterized by p_max for related scheduling problems but does not appear to settle F3||Cmax.
